content.title: RBC Heritage highlights: Matt Fitzpatrick beats Scottie Scheffler in playoff
content.text: Updated April 19, 2026, 6:24 p.m. ETThe PGA Tour's fourth signature event of 2026 is down to the fourth and final round.The RBC Heritage comes to a close Sunday at Harbour Town Golf Links on Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, where Matt Fitzpatrick...Follow along below for live leaderboard updates, highlights and more from the final round of the 2026 RBC Heritage.RBC Heritage leaderboardCheck tee times and keep tabs on every score posted at Harbour Town with the 2026 RBC Heritage live leaderboard. First playoff holeBoth players find the fairway off the tee, but into a brisk wind, they'll both have about 200 yards into the green with Ftizpatrick hitting first.Fitzpatrick hits an incredible shot into the green and will have 10 feet for birdie. Scheffler comes up about 50 or so yards short of the pin, a clear mishit. He'll have to get up and down for a chance at extending this.Scottie's pitch shot ends up 8 feet from the hole. Fitzpatrick has 13 feet to win his second Heritage title.He sinks it! Second win at the Heritage in a playoff for Fitzpatrick, both coming after incredible iron shots into the closing 18th. Heading to a playoffScottie Scheffler and Matt Fitzpatrick are going to a playoff after Fitzpatrick bogeys the 18th. Fitzpatrick beat Jordan Spieth to win the Heritage in 2023. Scheffler won it in 2024. Scottie Scheffler gets within oneMatt Fitzpatrick's lead is down to one with two holes left. World No. 1 has back-to-back birdies to get to 18 under. Gary Woodland hole-out eagle on 18What a shot! Si Woo Kim gets within 2It's not over yet. Si Woo Kim birdies the par-5 15th to get within two shots off Matt Fitzpatrick, who remains at 19 under. Big par save for FitzpatrickThe lead remains three with six to play. Fitzpatrick's lead is 3 at the turnScottie Scheffler adds his second birdie of the front nine on the ninth, but he still trails by 3 shots with nine holes to play. Matt Fitzpatrick is playing steady golf on Sunday, even as conditions have toughened. Matt Fitzpatrick's lead grows to 4A strong start for Fitz, who birdies two of his first three holes to move to 19 under and four shots ahead of Scottie Scheffler and Si Woo Kim. Patrick Cantlay moves to T-2 with eagleAnother eagle on Sunday at Harbour Town, this one courtesy of Patrick Cantlay on the second and moving him to T-2. Max Homa throws golf club just days after criticizing others for itMax Homa shot a final-round 2-under 69 at Harbour Town Golf Links on Sunday but it was the club he threw that was drawing the most attention.— Adam Schupak Rickie Fowler drains a bomb for eagle78 feet for eagle? That'll do every time. Nice putt, Rickie.How to watch the RBC HeritageHere's a look at the TV and streaming information for Sunday's final round of the RBC Heritage:Golf Channel: 1-3 p.m. ETCBS/Paramount+: 3-6 p.m. ETESPN+: 7 a.m.-6 p.m. ETSirius XM: 1-6 p.m. ETGet PGA Tour Live in ESPN+ Watch Golf Channel for free on Fubo Watch the PGA Tour on Paramount+How much money is up for grabs at the 2026 RBC Heritage?Just like the five other non-player hosted signature events, there's a $3.6 million first-place check up for grabs out of a $20 million total prize fund.
